blocks.text: New roots, an endless commitment.
“Ananta” means endless — and that's how we think about caring for our soil, our growers and the people we feed.

21 Ananta Farmers Market is a young family venture. We grow seasonal fruit and vegetables on our own farmland in Bullsbrook, on Perth's northern fringe, and partner with trusted local growers to round out the harvest. Everything is chosen the way we'd choose it for our own kitchen table.
We're just getting started — and we'd love for you to grow with us.
Values we won't compromise on
Grown with patience
We let produce ripen properly and harvest close to delivery — no long cold-storage, no force-ripening.
Fair to growers
We work directly with local growers and pay them fairly. A shorter chain is better for everyone.
Gentle on the planet
Spray-conscious growing, plastic-light packing and as little waste as we can manage.
Honest always
Clear pricing, clear provenance, and real people to talk to when you need us.

/sustainability.title: Good food shouldn't cost the earth.

blocks.text: We're a small farm with big intentions. Here's how we try to do right by the land, our growers and your kitchen.
Spray-conscious growing
We minimise chemical inputs, use integrated pest management and grow certified-organic lines where we can. We're transparent about how each item is grown.
Plastic-light packaging
Recyclable and compostable materials wherever possible, reusable delivery crates, and no single-use plastic when we can avoid it.
Shorter supply chains
Harvest-to-order and local sourcing mean fewer food miles and produce that lasts longer in your kitchen.
Less food waste
We sell "imperfect" produce proudly, compost what we can't sell, and donate surplus to local community groups.
Seasonal by design
Growing with the seasons needs less energy and water — and tastes better, too.
Caring for soil
Crop rotation, cover crops and composting keep our soil alive and productive for the long term.
Always improving, never greenwashing.
We're honest that we're at the start of our journey. We won't claim to be perfect — instead we'll keep measuring our impact and sharing real progress with you, season by season.
If you have ideas for how we can do better, we genuinely want to hear them.

How we keep your produce safe — and how to store it well.
Policies
Last updated: 27 September 2026

We handle, pack and deliver fresh produce in line with Australian food safety requirements, including the Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) Food Standards Code and applicable Western Australian food safety laws.
Our practices
Clean handling — produce is handled with good hygiene, clean equipment and clean hands at every step.
Cool chain — perishable items are kept cool from harvest through to delivery wherever possible.
Careful sourcing — produce we don't grow ourselves comes from trusted local growers who share our standards.
Traceability — we keep records so we can trace produce back to its source if ever needed.
Washing — some produce is washed before packing; some is not, to extend shelf life. Always wash produce before eating.
Allergen & cross-contact information

While fruit and vegetables are not common allergens, our produce may be grown, handled or packed in facilities that also handle nuts, gluten or other allergens. We cannot guarantee an allergen-free environment. If you have a serious allergy, please contact us before ordering.
Storing your produce
Refrigerate promptly — store leafy greens, berries and most vegetables in the fridge as soon as you can.
Keep some at room temperature — tomatoes, bananas, potatoes, onions and garlic do best in a cool, dark, dry spot.
Wash before eating — rinse fresh produce under running water before preparing or eating.
Separate — keep fresh produce away from raw meat and its juices.
Use your senses — when in doubt, throw it out.
If you have a concern
If you ever have a food safety concern about something from us, stop using the product and contact us immediately at hello@21anantafarmersmarket.com.au so we can investigate.
More information
For general food safety advice, see foodstandards.gov.au.

How 21 Ananta Farmers Market Pty Ltd collects, uses and protects your personal information.
Policies
Last updated: 27 September 2026

21 Ananta Farmers Market Pty Ltd (“we”, “us”, “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).
1. What information we collect
Identity & contact details — your name, email address, phone number and delivery address.
Business details — for trade accounts, your business name, ABN/ACN, business type and delivery location.
Order information — the products you buy, order history and delivery preferences.
Payment information — payments are processed by a third-party payment provider. We do not store full card numbers on our servers.
Technical data — cookies and basic analytics such as device type and pages visited, to keep the site working and improve it.
2. How we collect it

We collect information directly from you when you apply for a trade account, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact us. We also collect some technical information automatically through cookies (see section 8).
3. Why we collect and use it
To assess trade applications, including verifying ABNs with the Australian Business Register.
To process and deliver your orders and provide customer support.
To send order confirmations and service messages.
To send marketing communications where you have opted in (you can opt out anytime).
To meet our legal and tax obligations.
To improve our products, website and service.
4. Disclosure to third parties

We only share your information with parties who help us run our business, such as delivery providers, our email provider and our payment processor. We require them to protect your information. We do not sell your personal information. We will not disclose your information overseas unless required to provide a service to you, and only with appropriate safeguards.
5. Direct marketing
We will only send you marketing emails if you have opted in. Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link, and you can also email us to opt out at any time.
6. Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from misuse, loss and unauthorised access, including secure (HTTPS) connections and restricted access to data. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we work hard to safeguard your information.
7. Access and correction
You may request access to, or correction of, your personal information by contacting us. We will respond within a reasonable period.
8. Cookies
We use one essential cookie to remember your cookie choice and, with your consent, analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand how the site is used. Read our full Cookie Policy for details.
9. Retention

We keep your personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes above or as required by law (for example, tax records must be kept for the period required by the Australian Taxation Office).
10. Complaints

If you have a privacy concern, please contact us first at hello@21anantafarmersmarket.com.au. If you're not satisfied with our response, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) at oaic.gov.au.

These Terms of Sale govern your purchase of products from 21 Ananta Farmers Market Pty Ltd (“we”, “us”, “our”), whether retail or wholesale. By placing an order, you agree to these terms. Please read them with our Privacy Policy, Returns & Refunds Policy and Shipping & Delivery Policy.
1. About us
21 Ananta Farmers Market Pty Ltd is an Australian business selling fresh fruit, vegetables and related products. Our ACN is 699 516 893.
2. Orders
An order is an offer to buy. Your order is accepted when we send you an order confirmation.
We may decline or cancel an order — for example if a product is unavailable, there is a pricing error, or we cannot deliver to your area. If we cancel, we will refund any payment already made.
Because we sell fresh produce, exact weights and sizes can vary slightly. We pick the best available and aim to match your order as closely as possible.
3. Prices and GST
All prices are in Australian dollars (AUD).

Basic fresh fruit and vegetables are GST-free under the A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999. Where a product is taxable, the price shown includes GST and this is itemised on your tax invoice.
Delivery fees (if any) are shown before you pay.
We may change prices at any time, but changes won't affect orders we've already accepted.
4. Payment

Online payments are processed securely by our payment provider, Stripe. We accept major cards and supported wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay. Your card details are handled by Stripe and never stored on our servers.
5. Delivery and pickup
Delivery and pickup are covered by our Shipping & Delivery Policy. Risk in the products passes to you on delivery or collection.
6. Your consumer rights
Our products come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. Nothing in these terms limits those rights. See our Returns & Refunds Policy for how to make a claim.
7. Food safety and allergens

We handle fresh produce in line with Australian food safety standards (see Food Safety). Produce may be grown or packed in facilities that also handle allergens. Always wash fresh produce before eating.
8. Cancellations and changes
If you need to change or cancel an order, contact us as soon as possible. Because produce is picked to order, we may not be able to change an order once it has been packed or dispatched.
9. Trade accounts

Trade accounts are offered at our discretion to businesses with a valid ABN. You are responsible for keeping your portal login secure and for orders placed through it. Let us know immediately if you suspect unauthorised use.
10. Liability
To the extent permitted by law, and subject to your rights under the Australian Consumer Law, our liability for any product is limited to replacing the product or refunding its price.
11. Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of Western Australia and the Commonwealth of Australia. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of Western Australia.
12. Contact
Questions about these terms? Email hello@21anantafarmersmarket.com.au.
Your rights under the Australian Consumer Law, and how we make things right.
Policies
Last updated: 27 September 2026
Your rights under the Australian Consumer Law
Our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law (ACL). Among other things, the produce we sell must be:
of acceptable quality — safe, lasting and free from defects, given that it is fresh, perishable produce;
fit for purpose and matching its description; and
as shown in any sample or demonstration.

You are entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure, and to compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage. If the failure is minor, we may choose to replace the item or refund you.
Fresh produce — a quick note
Fruit and vegetables are perishable, and natural variation in size, shape and colour is normal and not a fault. If produce arrives damaged, spoiled or not of acceptable quality, you are covered.
If something isn't right
Please check your order on arrival and contact us within 24 hours of delivery or pickup if anything is not of acceptable quality. Email hello@21anantafarmersmarket.com.au with:
your order number;
the item(s) affected; and
a quick photo if you can — it helps us improve.
How we'll fix it
Replacement in your next delivery, or
Refund or credit for the affected item(s), or
a refund of the full order where there is a major failure.

For perishable goods we generally don't require you to return the item — we may simply ask for a photo. Approved refunds are made to your original payment method (or as credit if you prefer), usually within 5–10 business days of approval.
Change of mind

As we sell fresh, perishable food picked to order, we're generally unable to accept returns for change of mind once an order is packed or dispatched. This does not affect your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
Cancellations
If you need to cancel before your order is packed, contact us as soon as possible and we'll refund you in full. Once an order is picked, packed or dispatched, we may not be able to cancel it.
Orders we can't fulfil
If we're unable to supply all or part of your order (for example, a crop is unavailable), we'll let you know and refund the affected items.
More information
Read more about your consumer rights at accc.gov.au/consumers.
